analytical_variants.label: IST with isolated joined theory/practice appointments
analytical_variants.scope: At each instructor theory commitment, reserve source-required individual practices using the actual shared resource calendars
analytical_variants.rationale: Test whether planning the prerequisite chain together improves completed training without shortening practice, changing learning quality or adding capacity.
limitations: Additional synthetic policy, not a Daniel-reported or Annina-reported process rule.
Greedy, stable participant order; no global packing optimality or forecast of future arrivals.
All follow-ups must finish inside the existing observation horizon; no additional maximum-wait assumption introduced.

Known feasible first-start deadlines are held before practice planning. A failed complete chain commits no partial practice bookings, preserves feasible theory and explicitly escalates normal follow-up planning.
Source durations, individual practice and accrued work costing remain unchanged; no measured savings assumed.

analytical_variants.label: Combined S7 recovery with joined theory/practice appointments
analytical_variants.scope: Joined follow-up reservations added to the explicit post-breach recovery component
analytical_variants.rationale: Compare the scheduling component both alone and in the combined recovery policy using identical annual demand and resources.
limitations: The S0_JOINED mechanism and limitations apply; original S7 and S7_RECOVERY are retained as separate comparisons.
No new training duration, competence equivalence, trainer availability or cost saving is assumed.
Booking practice early can delay later or lower-priority arrivals; future demand is not known at reservation time.

analytical_variants.label: Combined S7 with explicit post-infeasibility recovery
limitations: Keeps original S7 unchanged; new policy variant requires explicit recovery quota.
Protect physically feasible original start deadlines, then favour priority1 whole-workflow progress with aged lower-priority appointment share.
Preserve compatible grouping after ageing; greedy calendar feasibility is not a global optimum.
No measured annual volume, staffing, cash saving or revenue benefit.
